Description: Correspondence and details of meetings between the Minister for Data Protection, the Department of the Minister for Data Protection, the Department of the Taoiseach and the Irish Data Protection Commissioner’s Office on the compliance of the website datasummitdublin.ie with the Irish Data Protection Act and S. I. No. 535 of 2003 as amended by SI 526 of 2008. Details of decisions concerning who is the Data Controller for the website and the conference extracts or details of the contract between the Department of the Taoiseach and Happening Conferences & Events Limited, 3 Wellington Park, Belfast BT9 6DJ, with respect to the role under the Irish Data Protection Act of each party. Communications between the Minister for Data Protection, the Department of the Minister for Data Protection, the Department of the Taoiseach and the Irish Data Protection Commissioner’s Office between the 23 March 2017 and the 6th April 2017, concerning the lack of a privacy policy on the website datasummitdublin.ie and between the Minister for Data Protection, the Department of the Taoiseach and Happening Conferences & Events Limited whether the conference is a government conference organised by Minister for Data Protection and/or the Department of the Taoiseach. Details of any sponsorships made by the Minister for Data Protection and/or the Department of the Taoiseach and details of any sponsorships received by the Minister for Data Protection, the Department of the Taoiseach in relation to the Data Summit.

Copies of all representations made to the Taoiseach on the topic of Brexit between March 1, 2017 and May 4, 2017.
